scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @las/core && npm run build -w @las/storage && npm run dev -w @las/server
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/storage apps/server && npm run build -w @las/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @las/core && npm run build -w @las/storage && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @las/server
